title: To end polio, we must reach children still being missed
description: Most families who come to Mirwais Hospital in Afghanistan’s southern Kandahar province arrive because illness or injury has already struck. Abdul Rahman’s father made the difficult one-hour journey for a different reason: to protect his 4-year-old son from polio. title: Trump on Iran War: It will end soon
description: President Trump expressed optimism that the conflict with Iran would end soon, though he didn’t provide specific details on how this would occur. He ruled out a pre-election strike.

title: Gaza patients lose access to specialized burn treatment amid materials shortage
description: DUBAI: Doctors without Borders has stopped producing specialized 3D-printed masks for patients with severe facial burns in Gaza after restrictions on medical supplies prevented the organization from obtaining essential materials The organization has warned children may be left with permanent disabilities as a result of the shortages, which come amid wider restrictions affecting humanitarian institutions operating in Gaza. title: Bangladesh bets on atomic energy as power starts up in first nuclear reactor
description: DHAKA: Bangladesh’s first nuclear power plant has officially started up one of its reactors, authorities said on Friday, marking the beginning of an electricity generation process that would eventually supply more than 10 percent of the country’s energy needs. Located on the banks of the Padma River, the Russian-built Rooppur Nuclear Power Plant was authorized to begin operations by the Bangladesh Atomic Energy Regulatory Authority a day earlier.

title: Thousands of students, workers protest in Italy under heavy security
description: Thousands of students and workers protested across Italy, demanding increased school funding and cost-of-living relief, while the police maintained a strong presence to prevent clashes. The protests are part of a wider movement similar to those in France and Spain.

title: Iran Guards say two tankers halted after 'incidents' in Hormuz
description: The Iranian Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) reported that two oil tankers experienced an incident in the Strait of Hormuz after they allegedly ignored warnings and tried navigating an unauthorized route.

title: With no majority, what options remain for Israel’s Netanyahu, Eisenkot?
description: Neither Netanyahu nor Eisenkot won a majority, leaving open questions on forming a coalition. Both leaders are seeking ways to expand their support.

title: Azerbaijan’s president skips Turkiye-hosted summit, stirring talk of a rift with ally Ankara
description: Azerbaijani President Ilham Aliyev did not attend a Turkiye-hosted summit, leading to speculation about tensions due to Azerbaijan’s hijab ban and ties with Israel. Foreign Minister Jeyhun Bayramov represented Azerbaijan instead.

title: Omani Navy: 25 Crew members evacuated from ship off Musandam
description: The Omani Navy evacuated 25 crew members from a burning commercial vessel off the coast of Musandam. The ship, flying a Panamanian flag, caught fire after being targeted, prompting a coordinated evacuation and medical care for the crew.
